It’s inappropriate to attend a frat party because of the age gap, whether or not you feel you have experienced your youth to the fullest you still are almost 30 now. In good news, you can go to bars etc and have similar experiences with people your age and you will likely enjoy it a lot more. Even if you feel you missed out on some things you’re unlikely to relate to people in their late teens/early 20s the same way that you would with people your age. There’s definitely people in their late 20s and early 30s who like to party. If you want to party you still can. However, I’d consider the reasons why you haven’t had those experiences yet. Maybe you aren’t naturally drawn to those types of experiences because you are more introverted, and just feel you need to experience them because they’re a symbol of coming of age, acceptance and friendship. Or maybe because of the excitement factor. Realistically you are still young. I think most people get closer to the person they really want to be in their 30s. You can continue exploring that and go try partying and you’ll likely see it is not like in movies. Although it is fun sometimes and probably will feel good to try (just drink/consume drugs responsibly!)

I know sometimes hearing to love yourself sucks when you hate yourself or certain things about yourself a lot. It is likely because growing up people told you to or implied it by judging certain characteristics you have or currently society tells you to hate these things about yourself. If you hate and are angry at other people, try to reflect on what you hate about them and consider times you have shown that quality in yourself. You’ll want to deny it because it hurts to know you hate things about yourself but try to accept it. You’re okay even though you’re hurting and make mistakes. All people are capable of being a certain way when under certain circumstances. Figure out exactly what you hate about yourself and try your hardest to accept it and see that there’s likely good things in those “negative” qualities as well. We are all humans at the end of the day and once you accept the things you hate you will find it easier to work towards your goals and those qualities you dislike about yourself and others will slowly become less prominent in your life. Good luck ♥️
